islands.observation: Isometric of a built-in seat unit: tall vertical slat back over a three-drawer base, with a table top extending to the right on one visible leg.
Plan outline of two joined zones: a narrower seat-back zone and a wider table zone. Dimension labels 187, 115 and 160 are present.
Opposite isometric of the slat back face and drawer base, with the table top on two visible legs at its free side.

Side profile: thin tall back panel above the drawer carcass, a plinth at the base, and a table top on a single visible leg in profile.
Back-face elevation of the slat back with seven columns, and the seat-base lower zone showing two table legs beneath the top.

characteristics.statement: Seat base is a closed carcass with three side-by-side drawer fronts stacked in one row, plus a plinth strip beneath.
Tall slat back of seven vertical slat columns in two rows, with rectangular cut-out insets, rising above the seat base.
Slat back and drawer carcass surfaces are wood-veneer board, oak-look satin finish (inferred from grain rendering).
Table top is a separate light grey/beige surface attached to the side of the seat base and supported by two legs at its free side.
Table top support: two black metal tube legs under the free edge.
Slat back panel thickness is 20 mm as dimensioned on the side view, but the normalized measurement conflicts with the drawing text.

islands.observation: Plan of an L-shaped run: 416 long top arm, 300 overall left depth, 260 inner return, 25 dimension at the lower-left end, 65 and 42 wall/offset dimensions, and a 45° corner cut. Shows a sink opening outline on the top arm.

Isometric render of the L-shaped base run with a chamfered end, a sink cutout, a worktop with a brown stone-effect corner, a three-drawer stack near the tall end, a separate hanging upper unit at left, and a tall tower at the right end. Shows the base run is not a full-height corner.

Elevation of the first wing: left 69 tall unit with one tall leaf, 180 base run with five tall doors and a narrow end strip, two horizontal upper fronts under a 75 clearance, three upper doors at the right, a column of two doors over two drawers, and a 184 open/tower zone with a 94 return.

Elevation of the second wing: upper hanging unit 84 wide and 115 high with a pair of doors, base run 84 plus 151 with three doors, a three-drawer stack, one more door near a 265 tall tower column at the right end.

understanding.name: L-shaped kitchen
understanding.description: A two-wing L-shaped kitchen with a base run and worktop on the top arm, a separate hanging upper unit on the second wing, and a tall tower at the right end. The base run has door and drawer banks, and the upper cabinets are partly separate from the base.

characteristics.statement: Base run carries a continuous worktop with a sink cutout; the worktop covers the base cabinets and stops before the tall tower.
Base carcasses with hinged doors on the top arm (five tall leaves) and a three-drawer stack plus door on the second wing.
Upper cabinets: three doors on the right of the top arm, two horizontal lift-up fronts under a 75 clearance, and a separate hanging pair of doors 84 wide and 115 high on the second wing.
Tall tower column at the right end (265 high) reads as a fixed tall unit, not part of the base run.
Carcass and doors in LDSP 17 mm, sage green matte coating (colour inferred from render).
Worktop in laminate-coated 30 mm board with beige stone-effect finish (inferred from render colour).
